message:
Let me look at the commit "25ffd197 Add seedcorpus for flac tool fuzzer" and "aa414e46" more carefully. The issue 42529733 is specifically about fuzzer_tool_flac with MSAN (use-of-uninitialized-value). Let me look at the git history around the tool_flac fuzzer and the decode.c file. Let me check the commit that's right after HEAD that relates to the tool_flac fuzzer.

Let me look at the commits between HEAD and the fix. Let me check what commits come after HEAD in the history that touch the tool_flac fuzzer or decode.c.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/master 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "---branches---"; git branch -a</｜｜DSML｜｜>
